svg.title: Rubric items, components and course modules
svg.desc: Nine rubric items each map to one component. Components draw on Text Analytics, New Media and Sentiment Mining, Text Processing using Machine Learning, and Conversational UIs. Bank entity recognition and LLM aspect categorisation are planned; annotation is done and the fine-tuned sentiment model is trained.
